newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle very slow at $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle very slow at $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 100 head slaughter steers; 68,200 head confirmed for week to date which includes 14,000 formulated and 2,700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 67.00. Confirmed - 100
